entityDescription:
In AID, we take our passion and commitment beyond borders, positively impacting communities around the world. Proud of our global influence, we do not confine ourselves to regions where we have already worked. Our sights are set on expanding our footprint, reaching wherever we can make a significant difference.
We offer innovative and sustainable solutions in complex and diverse environments. At AID, we are dedicated to forging strategic partnerships that allow us to work in harmony with the needs and goals of these prominent institutions, ensuring that our architecture is not only aesthetic and functional but also a catalyst for development and global well-being. Our efforts are being rewarded with steady growth, both nationally and internationally. At AID, we are excited about the future, continuing our mission to positively impact the world through innovative and sustainable architecture and engineering.
• Exponential Growth: This year, we have reached a milestone with growth exceeding 40% compared to the previous year.
• International Expansion: We continue to transcend borders, offering projects in new countries and consolidating our global presence.
• New Staff Additions: We have enriched our team with the addition of new personnel, adding diversity and fresh perspectives to our company.
Committed to quality based on ISO 9001 standards.
In AID, we collaborate with partners who share our vision of sustainability and responsibility-centered work. We have had the privilege of working with renowned entities and multilateral organizations such as the European Commission, the UN, and the Inter-American Development Bank (BID), as well as prominent leaders in the construction industry such as Acciona, ACS, Ferrovial, and Eiffage. These partnerships reflect our shared commitment to generating a positive and enduring impact on society.
We promote the general interests of society through architecture and engineering, disciplines aimed at satisfying the basic needs of human beings, such as housing in dignified and secure conditions. We recognize the fundamental implications of our activities on collective well-being, including proper land management, responsible management of natural resources, and the preservation of our heritage. To achieve this, we commit to transitioning towards areas of cooperation and other ethical sectors that concretely and significantly improve people's quality of life. We focus on collaborating with clients who share our commitment and are dedicated to supporting sectors, areas, and populations that align with the values and objectives of AID.

entityDescription:
With the advent of large launchers, the price of cargo to low Earth orbit has plummeted to new lows. Soon, a future in which cargo prices from here to LEO are the same as from here to Shenzhen seems possible. This opens up the prospect of using space as a place for economic activity, not just for data, telecommunications or images, but also for physical goods and materials. Space is indeed a very attractive place to do this: the absence of gravity opens up drastically simpler synthesis routes for a range of chemical, physical and biological compounds, while the environment provides infinite free energy, heat, cold and quasi-perfect vacuum - commodities that would require drastic amounts of energy on Earth.
As attractive as this vision is, the current state of technology stands in the way of this future. In fact, with the exception of the launcher, the entire space technology stack in use today is still based on paradigms from over half a century ago, when space assets were essentially very expensive disposable items. As travel to and from space has become routine, this needs to change to make the entire industry sustainable and resource efficient.
Starflight Dynamics' mission is to provide the enabling technologies to bring industry to space and enable future production there. As such, the company is working to provide the full range of services required, from reusable transport platforms to reusable space cargo containers and, of course, large solar-powered production platforms that will be the production sites of the future. 
Starflight Dynamics will generate revenue from two main sources:
- Once established, the company will build and operate robotic in-orbit production facilities, where customers can run their processes in dedicated production cargo containers.
- Along the way, the company will commercialise the technologies developed for this, from agile and long-endurance platforms to re-entry technologies and the like. To this end, the company has partnered with established industrialists in the field to provide derived products for niche applications.

Our organization was established on the 14th of February 2008.

It is named after the ancient city of Kition which was found in the area where nowadays, the town of Larnaca, Cyprus, is located. entityName: Instytut Geofizyki Polskiej Akademii Nauk (Institute of Geophysics of the Polish Academy of Sciences)
entityDescription:
Institute of Geophysics of the Polish Academy of Sciences - a scientific institute of the Polish Academy of Sciences based in Warsaw, dealing with research and monitoring of geophysical processes. He is a member of the Center for Earth and Planet Research - GeoPlanet. Since 2023, the director of the Institute is prof. Ph.D. Paweł M. Rowiński.
The Institute of Geophysics has been operating since 1953, initially (until 1970) as the Department of Geophysics. In the initial period, research conducted there was limited to selected issues in the field of seismology, physics of the Earth's interior and terrestrial magnetism; other fields of geophysics were gradually added: physics of the atmosphere, ionosphere and magnetosphere, oceanology, planetary geodesy, hydrology.
In the years 1973-1978, some departments separated from the Institute of Geophysics of the Polish Academy of Sciences, creating independent research institutions: the Institute of Oceanology of the Polish Academy of Sciences and the Space Research Center of the Polish Academy of Sciences.
The Institute is currently conducting research in the following areas:
• Seismology - analysis of earthquakes and tremors induced by mining activities, seismicity of the European Union area and more broadly,
• Seismic studies of the lithosphere - the structure and geodynamics of the Earth's crust and upper mantle obtained based on deep seismic soundings and natural seismicity. organization and interpretation of active and passive seismic experiments aimed at identifying the structure of the crust and upper mantle of the Earth,
• Geophysical imaging - development and application of innovative imaging techniques, especially those based on the full wave field, seismic processing, depth imaging and denoising of seismic data.
• Theoretical geophysics – analysis of the physical laws governing geophysical processes and development of mathematical and numerical methods for describing these phenomena,
• Magnetism - development of magnetotelluric research methods, numerical modeling of electromagnetic induction processes in the Earth's interior, regional research on the structure of the Earth's crust, paleomagnetic research and magnetic properties of intrusive and sedimentary rocks,
• Polar and marine research - analysis of geophysical and environmental data obtained at the Polish Polar Station on Spitsbergen and Hornsund, research on changes in abiotic features of the natural environment in the polar zones,
• Hydrology and hydrodynamics – transport and mixing of pollutants in surface waters, modeling of flood wave transformation using hydraulic and hydrological models, modeling of flood risk by implementing the latest achievements of the statistical theory of extreme phenomena, climate change,
• Atmospheric physics - analysis of the variability of the ozone layer and solar radiation on various time scales, transparency of the atmosphere, atmospheric electricity, structure of storm clouds and discharges.
Currently, the Institute conduct 86 projects of scientific.

The company specializes in professional competencies in component design and layout, structural mechanical optimization, and manufacturing. It offers professional training of future additive manufacturing (AM) specialists in the metal and plastics sector.

entityDescription:
AlphaEO is a downstream Earth Observation start-up providing environmental dashboards which employs cutting-edge Earth Observation (EO) technology, The SaaS model exemplifies a sophisticated downstream application tailored for a broad spectrum of domains beyond its initial agricultural focus. This interactive platform harnesses the power of data fusion, combining optical and radar satellite imagery to deliver comprehensive, near-real-time insights. While AlphaFarm demonstrates its prowess in precision agriculture, the underlying technology of the AlphaEO dashboard extends its utility across various sectors including environmental monitoring, disaster response, and natural resource management.
For environmental monitoring, the dashboard can analyse deforestation rates, track biodiversity changes, or monitor water bodies' health, offering vital data for conservation efforts and policy-making. In disaster response, the ability to quickly interpret changes in the landscape becomes invaluable. The dashboard's rapid processing of EO data can aid in assessing damage, coordinating relief efforts, and planning recovery operations by providing accurate, timely information on affected areas. Natural resource management benefits from the ability to monitor changes in landscapes, such as the depletion of natural resources or the impact of mining activities, ensuring sustainable exploitation and conservation of these resources.
At its core, the AlphaEO dashboard embodies a modular and scalable solution, designed to adapt and integrate specific modules tailored to the needs of various domains. Its user-friendly interface ensures that complex satellite data is accessible and actionable, enabling decision-makers, researchers, and professionals across different sectors to leverage EO data effectively. Through continuous innovation and adaptation, the AlphaEO dashboard stands as a versatile tool, ready to meet the challenges and opportunities of a rapidly changing world.
